answer.rationale: Likely action is switch_primary_vendor per c2 (proven quick onboarding, accurate invoicing, sharp unit-cost cut). But c2 is a single-site memory and the current primary (whoever holds the present contract) is the one whose renewal is expiring, not the low-cost vendor; I want c2 archived to confirm the low-cost vendor's onboarding was genuinely quick and accurate last time before relying on them to absorb 94%-of-capacity volume in 14 days. Also verifying c6 to check whether the longer-term incumbent pricing was the primary cost lever (if the incumbent is not the low-cost vendor in memory, c6's volume pricing may not transfer — re-running c6 against the wrong vendor would mislead the decision). Two-pull budget is tight so I skip c3/c4/c5/c1.
